summary.notes: The terminology refactor request introduces two new canonical architecture terms ('truth_store', 'decision_layer') with zero citation from any role-matched canonical source. Both are strong architecture claims that violate CLAUDE.md Section 10 (strong claim discipline) and Section 5.2 (proof model). Additionally, the proposed rename of README_LAYER2.md — a named canonical source in CLAUDE.md Section 2.1 — is a governance action requiring CLAUDE.md amendment before it can be authorized. The overall verdict is BLOCK. Resolution path requires: (1) role-matched citation from SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_SEQUENCE_v1.md establishing 'truth_store' and 'decision_layer' as canonical replacement terms; (2) formal governance amendment to CLAUDE.md Section 2.1 and 2.2 authorizing the README_LAYER2.md rename; (3) review of all canonical documents per CLAUDE.md Section 11 before any contract-affecting change proceeds. Escalation to canonical-role-auditor is triggered per agent failure mode rules.
